name: RC-B10-0482/2026 – After § 9 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text: 9a. Urges all the Member States to refrain from any military involvement that could contribute to further regional escalation, and instead prioritise diplomatic efforts towards de-escalation and peace; expresses deep concern over the decision of several Member States to deploy military personnel, radars and air defence systems to Saudi Arabia; warns that deploying military forces in an active conflict zone increases dangers to shipping in the region and the EU’s supply lines, and risks dragging the EU into direct hostilities; stresses that protecting oil infrastructure must not serve as a justification for further military involvement in the conflict;
